fusions.name: Poltergeist Shove
fusions.desc: An unseen hand of force strikes an enemy up to 6 tiles away for 12 damage, rising to 1.3 times at full range, and shoves it back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Lent Strength
fusions.desc: Hurls a fist of arcana that deals 30 damage. When it hits, every ally near you deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Disembodied Grip
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to conjure a floating hand beside you for 14 seconds. It strikes enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Steady Grip
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your critical hit chance rises by 15% for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
